description: Install rules for scaffold/model/, the exact copy of the model project that node dev/tools/import-model.mjs makes. toolkit init, sync, and doctor install every file in scaffold/model/ byte for byte, except what these rules say. Rules: templates/TEMPLATE-LANGUAGE.md. Every rule in only, generated, fill, jsonRemove, and lineRemove must match something in the model, or the import stops.

generated.note: Installed from the model when missing; init then runs toolkit memory reindex. Sync never records or replaces it.

Installed from the model when missing. toolkit index knowledge rewrites only its table rows from each topic's SOURCE-RECORD.md and keeps the model's text around them. Sync never records or replaces it.

notes.exclude: The import always leaves out .git, and every .sfdx/ and .vscode/ folder (approved item 22), __pycache__/ folder, and .DS_Store file at any depth. It also leaves out every file the model's Git ignores and does not track, so a real memory note or work item in Mike's model folder never ships; the model tracks its .memory/ and .work-items/ templates on purpose. The patterns under exclude are local files the model's own .gitignore names, or files one person keeps for themselves (CLAUDE.local.md, .claude/settings.local.json, an Obsidian settings folder). They are not required to match anything: they stop such a file from being copied if it ever appears in the model folder.
notes.tracker:local: The local tracker is the only tracker that keeps work items in the project, so .work-items/ and the rule for its folders (approved item 8) install only for it.
notes.memory:builtin: Built-in memory is the only memory system that keeps files in the project, so .memory/ installs only for it.
notes.salesforce: Decided from each file's content. sfdx-project.json and .forceignore configure the Salesforce CLI. delivery/ holds client briefs, data loads, and deployment manifests (approved item 16). tools/kb/ builds the Salesforce metadata dependency graph from force-app/, and tools/permissions/ checks permission sets. .claude/protected-orgs.json and the two guard hooks protect Salesforce orgs (approved item 17). The sf-* skills in .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/ are Salesforce skills (approved item 18). Nine rules are Salesforce-only: check-deployment-contents, component-tracker, confirm-salesforce-changes, dependency-graph (force-app/ and tools/kb/), permissions-source-control (force-app/ permission sets), production-data-changes, project-file-locations (its first line says it owns where a Salesforce project's client-work files go), record-deployment-steps (delivery/deployment/), and salesforce-org-safety. publish-project-documents stays in every project: most of its paths are general, and a path that does not exist costs nothing. system-guide/, tests/TEST-PLAN-TEMPLATE.md, requirements/, and SOUL.md are general.
notes.host:codex: Codex reads .codex/ (its project settings and hooks) and .agents/skills/. Claude Code reads neither.
notes.host:claude-code: Only Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md, .claude/settings.json, .claude/output-styles/, and .claude/skills/. Codex reads AGENTS.md and the rules through it, and runs the guard scripts in .claude/hooks/ from .codex/hooks.json, so .claude/rules/, .claude/hooks/, and .claude/protected-orgs.json install for both hosts.
notes.generated: A toolkit command keeps these two files current (toolkit memory reindex, toolkit index knowledge), so the model's copy is the starting text and sync never replaces it.
notes.fill: Init replaces <Project name> with the project name on heading lines only. The fill-in guide comments in AGENTS.md and PROJECT.md name <Project name> as text and stay as they are. Every other angle-bracket prompt stays for the agent to fill.
notes.jsonRemove: In a project that is not a Salesforce project, the Salesforce guard hooks, the dependency graph Stop hook (tools/kb/), and the sf and sfdx permission rules are removed from the model's .claude/settings.json before it is merged, and the two guard hooks from .codex/hooks.json. .codex/hooks.json holds nothing else, so it is not installed at all then. When Salesforce is turned off later, sync applies the same removals to a .claude/settings.json the project has not changed, so no hook runs a left-over Salesforce script.
notes.lineRemove: In a project that is not a Salesforce project, the Salesforce CLI and tools/kb/ lines are removed from the model's .gitignore, and sync removes them from a .gitignore the project has not changed when Salesforce is turned off. __pycache__/ and *.pyc stay: they are general.
